# A — competing-risks lifetime PD (generated by src/phase2/fit_A.py)

**Prepayment as competing risk vs censoring — loans issued Jan–Sep 2015 (n = 194,363; observable to month 36 at the data cut):** lifetime PD treating prepayment as censoring 18.2%, competing-risks 13.6%, actual cumulative default by month 36 14.7%. (Fig. 4 of the article uses this population.)

Train: 120,683 loans (2012-09..2013-12), 3,030,762 loan-months, 14,902 defaults, 61,594 prepayments; Newton converged in 10 iterations.

## Loan-level, OOT 2015 (final outcome)

Gini of lifetime PD = 36.4 (M2 PD alone: 36.7); mean lifetime PD 13.42% vs final bad rate 14.88%.


## A/E@36 by M2-PD quintile band (1 = safest; cut points on train) — gate R7-2

The gradient (safest band under-predicted) is already present on validation 2014, before the 2015–16 drift: it comes from the lp slope being fitted on M2's in-sample scores, not only from drift.
